reply.text: {"say":"Shoulder day built around lateral raise variations for width, with a press and rear delts to round it out, all from your dumbbells and cables.","title":"Shoulders: Width Focus","days":[{"name":"Shoulders","exercises":[{"key":"seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the descent, press strong."},{"key":"dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":4,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height."},{"key":"cable-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Steady tension, no swinging."},{"key":"leaning-dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lean away from the working side."},{"key":"behind-the-back-cable-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the torso still."},{"key":"single-arm-dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the top."},{"key":"machine-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze at the peak."},{"key":"dumbbell-rear-delt-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hinge forward and open wide."}]}],"unmet":[]}
